D1_exact_self_similarity.name: ExactSelfSimilar(G, H)
D1_exact_self_similarity.requirement: Typed graph isomorphism φ : G ≅ H for proper subgraph H, preserving carriers, authority, transformations, direction, source/target types, consumer attachment, fate status, source-threading, additional-input boundaries, invalid-domain boundaries.

D2_typed_recursive_self_similarity.name: TypedRecursivePattern(P, G)
D2_typed_recursive_self_similarity.requirement: At least two non-overlapping occurrences of nontrivial pattern P at distinct declared scales, preserving role structure, type compatibility, transformation direction, consumer locality, sufficiency/loss relations, authority boundaries.
D2_typed_recursive_self_similarity.minimum_candidate_pattern: authoritative carrier → derived representation → consumer-relative fate classification
D2_typed_recursive_self_similarity.weakness_test: Check if minimum pattern matches nearly every information system (modularity only).

D3_renormalisation_invariance.name: RenormalisationInvariance
D3_renormalisation_invariance.requirement: Coarse-graining R : Graph → Graph with frozen grouping/quotient/retained fields/consumer transport/fate aggregation/authority aggregation/unresolved rules, plus predeclared invariant I such that I(R(G)) = I(G) or predeclared scale law.

D4_box_cover_scaling.name: BoxCoverScaling
D4_box_cover_scaling.requirement: Graph metric d and box-cover rule defining N_B(ℓ) (min or approx boxes of diameter ≤ ℓ). Candidate law N_B(ℓ) ∝ ℓ^(-d_B) over declared scale range.

D5_statistical_self_similarity.name: StatisticalSelfSimilarity
D5_statistical_self_similarity.requirement: Growing family G1..Gn generated independently of the fractality test. Single hand-constructed graph insufficient.

claim_boundary: Even positive results establish only bounded fractality under frozen criteria; no universal/physical/promotion claims.
